verdict.rationale: A GPU ships with a control UI (the NVIDIA app is used to update games' DLSS features), so API/UI parity is a fair question. However, the evidence documents no programmatic API that mirrors those UI controls, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. CUDA and its toolkits are compute programming building blocks, not an API equivalent of the UI, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
